main.description: Lists an actor's indexed reposts, one representative per subject URI regardless of subject CID. No authentication is required. Duplicates use the earliest createdAt, with URI ascending on ties. Returns raw repost records including subject, via, and signatures when present; subjects are not hydrated and need not be indexed.

actor.description: Repository-owner DID of the actor whose reposts to list.

sortDirection.description: Sort by representative repost createdAt and URI; defaults to desc.

limit.description: Maximum relationships per page; defaults to 25.

cursor.description: Opaque next-page cursor bound to sortDirection; keep all other parameters unchanged between pages.

errors.name: InvalidRequest
errors.description: The actor DID, sort direction, limit, cursor, or another query parameter is invalid.

errors.name: RepostQueryFailed
errors.description: The actor reposts query failed; retry the request.

cursor.description: Next-page cursor; omitted when pagination is complete.
